Beige vs White early adipogenesis analyed at the gene level

```{r libs, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
library(BPCells)
library(Seurat)
library(clusterProfiler)
library(dplyr)
library(enrichplot)
library(ggplot2)
library(ggrepel)
library(here)
library(tidyr)
```

```{r params}
module = "beige_vs_white"
dataname = "downsample"
load_data = T #loading data
subset_data = F

rmd_filename = "supp_figS5_beige_vs_white-gene_level"
i_am(file.path("figures", paste0(rmd_filename,".Rmd")))
odir = here("output", module, dataname)
```


```{r setup}
set.seed(8)
fig_dir = here("figures", rmd_filename)
if (!dir.exists(fig_dir)) dir.create(fig_dir, recursive = TRUE)
knitr::opts_chunk$set(fig.path = paste0(fig_dir, "/"),
                      dev = c("png","pdf"))

if (!dir.exists(odir)) dir.create(odir, recursive = TRUE)
```


```{r themes}
theme_hp = theme_classic(base_size = 15) +
  theme(axis.line = element_line(linewidth = 0.25),
        axis.ticks = element_line(linewidth = 0.25),
        strip.background = element_blank())
theme_set(theme_hp)
pal = c("#1F78B4","#85C2EA","#B3B3B3", "#F18486", "#E31A1C")
clusters = MetBrewer::met.brewer("Redon", 13)
spectral = rev(RColorBrewer::brewer.pal(n = 11, name = 'Spectral'))
```

## Read data

```{r}
if (subset_data){
  sbs = readRDS(here(odir, "10%_complete_analysis.rds"))
} else {
  sbs = readRDS(here(odir, "complete_analysis.rds"))
  DefaultAssay(sbs) = "RNA"
}
Idents(sbs) = "seurat_clusters"
sbs
all.genes = row.names(sbs)
table(Idents(sbs))
```

```{r B_umap}
DimPlot(sbs, cols= clusters, shuffle=T, label=T)
DimPlot(sbs, cols= clusters, shuffle=T, label=T)
```
## C: Full Cluster composition plot? 

### Column version

```{r wvb_proportion_test_columns}
ggplot(to_plot, aes(x=cluster, fill=cond.time, y=prop))  +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0.5, linewidth=0.4, colour="grey55") + 
  geom_bar(position="dodge", stat='identity') + 
  geom_errorbar( aes(ymin=conf.int.1, ymax=conf.int.2), 
                 position=position_dodge(0.9), width=0.4, linewidth=0.3) +
  scale_fill_manual(values=pal[c(1,2,4,5)]) + facet_wrap(~time, scales="free_x")  +
  scale_y_continuous(expand=c(0,0))
```
